sources.quote: Michael McCaffery is Chairman of Makena's Board of Directors. Mike was the firm's founding CEO and has also served as the Executive Chairman and Managing Partner. Prior to forming Makena Capital Management in 2005, Mike was the President and CEO of the Stanford Management Company ... Mike joined Robertson Stephens as Director of Investment Banking in 1988 ... Mike was named to the board of directors of NVIDIA Corp. in March 2015 and is a director of C3.ai.
sources.title: Why Makena - Makena Capital

sources.quote: Michael G. McCaffery · III · 68 · Lead Independent Director · 2009 · 2023 ... Mr. McCaffery has served as a member of our board of directors since March 2009.
sources.title: C3.ai, Inc. 2021 Proxy Statement

sources.quote: McCaffery, age 61, is chairman and managing director of Makena Capital Management, which he co-founded 10 years ago. From 2000 to 2006, he served as president and CEO of Stanford Management Co., which oversees Stanford University's endowment. He was previously chairman and CEO of the Robertson Stephens and Co. investment bank. ... McCaffery serves as a trustee of the Rhodes Scholarship Trust and is a director of C3 Energy. He is a member of the advisory boards of Accel Partners, Crosslink Capital, Sageview Capital, Silver Lake Partners, SPO Partners & Co. and Stadium Capital Management.
sources.title: NVIDIA Names Michael McCaffery, Persis Drell to Board of Directors

summary: Makena Capital's board page lists Michael McCaffery as Chairman of the Board; he was the firm's founding CEO (December 2005 - January 2013) and Managing Director since December 2005.
